title: REGENEROUS
reading: regeneration practiced in a generous mode by default, not a scarce one.

title: THE HEARTH / THE EARTH HEART / ART HEARTH
wordplay: HEARTH contains HEART, EARTH, HEAR, ART.
reading: the gathering-fire as Earth-as-heart, art as the place we hear each other. Four meanings folded into one syllable.

title: GIVING Be-EARTH TO AN EASY EARTH
wordplay: giving birth → giving be-earth (be + earth). "Easy Earth" as destination.
reading: birthing a way of being-with-earth that makes the planet easy to inhabit.

title: HOW TO LIVE REGENEROUSLY
reading: the practice question — how to embody regenerous living daily.

title: THE REBIRTH OF CARE
reading: care as the thing being reborn from the ashes.

title: THE BEAUTIFUL FUTURE / BUT TAKES OUR ALL / WE WALK UP TOGETHER
reading: the beautiful future is real, costs everything, and only happens through collective ascent.

title: FOR THRIVING THE FUTURE
wordplay: "for thriving" replacing "going forth"; thriving as the verb of futuring.
reading: future-making by the act of thriving, not surviving forward.

title: THE THRIVE-ALL OF THE BEST ADAPTED
wordplay: inverts "survival of the fittest" twice. Survival → thrive-all (everyone thrives). Fittest → best-adapted (adaptive fit, not raw competition).
reading: collective thriving by adaptive fit, not individual survival by competition.

title: FOREST FACADES
reading: the surfaces forests present versus the depth beneath. Possibly a critique of greenwashing as facade, or a recognition that even facades can host life.

title: FRACTAL FEDERATED FOREST
reading: forest as governance metaphor — fractally self-similar, federated, alive at every scale.

title: ZINES FROM THE SCENE
reading: ground-up documentation from the field/movement.

title: FineAnts
wordplay: fine + ants = finance. Ants as actual wealth carriers in nature.
reading: finance reframed as fine-ant-craft. Distributed, tireless, collective wealth movement instead of extractive individual gain.

title: MINTS ARE CURRENTSEE
wordplay: mint (money, fresh) + currents + sea + see → currency.
reading: currency as currents we can see, flowing waters rather than stockpiled coin. Mints as the moments money is fresh.

title: WEALTH WEAVER
reading: wealth as woven (relational, textile, communal) rather than mined or accumulated. The role of the one who weaves it together.

title: MONEY MAGNET / MOSAIC MINDSET
wordplay: MONEY and MAGNET frame a MOSAIC MINDSET inside.
reading: a mosaic mindset (many small pieces in relation) is itself the money magnet. Attraction by composition, not by chasing.

title: FLOW FINANCE AS FEEDBACK
reading: money as a feedback signal in flow systems, not a goal — finance as nervous-system signalling.

title: VALUE ADDED TENANTSEE
reading: tenants as those who add value (and see it). Reframes tenancy as value-creation rather than rent extraction.

title: CONTEXTUAL CURRENTSEES
reading: many local currencies as visible currents tuned to context. Plural, situated, watched.

title: ABUNDANCE SHARED = ABUNDANCE
reading: abundance is a property of sharing — unshared, it isn't abundance, it's hoarding.

title: FROM ABANDONMENT TO ABUNDONMENT
wordplay: abandonment → abundance via abun-don-ment (abundance + donment, the giving).
reading: the route from abandonment to abundance runs through donation, through letting go.

title: HOW DO WE GET TO ¥€$
reading: getting to yes through reconciling currencies (financial, cultural). Yes is what currencies are trying to spell.

title: THE D-MAND ECONOMY
wordplay: demand + d'mand (of-mind) + possible echo of "supply economy".
reading: an economy organised around demand-side coordination rather than supply-side push.

title: STORY SERVICE
reading: storytelling-as-service. The role/business of serving stories.

title: BEAUTIFUL WEALTH CARRIERS
reading: ants as the metaphor for who carries wealth in regenerative systems — small, many, beautiful, in service.

title: IS IT WASTE OR UNUSED EXCESS
reading: reframing waste as resource-not-yet-routed. Excess waiting for circulation.

title: SHARE + SHINE
reading: share to shine. Sharing as the medium of visibility and light.

title: PLAY CEREMONEY
reading: money as ceremony, play as the practice of moving it. Inverts money's seriousness without losing its ritual weight.

title: SERENDIPITY ENGINE
reading: an engine designed not for productivity but for the production of serendipitous encounters.

title: DECOY INFRASTRUCTURE
reading: infrastructure that misdirects predatory systems — defensive design through diversion.

title: WE FIND REASONANTS
reading: we don't just find reasons, we find reson-ants — distributed, resonant, swarm-finders of meaning.

title: BeEARTHING COHEREANTS
reading: birthing coherent collective intelligences. Coherence in ant-swarm form.

title: AGEANTS
reading: agents as ant-collectives across ages. AI agents reframed in the ant idiom.

title: FROM PERFORMANTS TO TRANSFORMANTS
reading: shift from performing to transforming — the ants stay, the verb upgrades.

title: FRACTAL FREE ANT CHEYS
reading: free agents organised fractally, ant-style. Free agencies as branches of the colony.

title: BRIDGING STORIES
reading: stories as the bridges between worlds, parties, futures.

title: NAMING IS REFRAMING
reading: to name something is already to reframe it. Naming carries framing power.

title: STORY SPELLING / IF YOU WERE TO WRITE YOUR OWN STORY WHAT IS THE ARC TOWARDS THE BEST POSSIBLE REALITY
reading: writing your own story is spell-craft. The prompt: arc your story towards the best possible reality.

title: STORY AS STRUCTURE
reading: story isn't decoration — it's load-bearing structure.

title: STORY STEWARD
reading: tending stories rather than owning or authoring them.

title: METAPHORS MATTER
reading: metaphors are the operating layer; choose them deliberately.

title: SOULFULL MEDIAM
wordplay: soul + full + medium + media + I am.
reading: a medium that is soul-full and self-knowing — "I am" the medium. Media as soul-carrier.

title: WHAT'S THE NODE / DOWNLOAD
reading: asking what the transmission is and what node it's coming through.

title: THE JACK SPARROW MURMURACTION
wordplay: murmuration (starling flock) + action + Jack Sparrow (trickster sailor).
reading: trickster-led collective action that moves like a flock. Coordinated improvisation.

title: TRINITY OF STORY
reading: three directions every story moves — upward (transcendence), inward (depth), outward (relation).

title: ARTCHIVE
reading: archiving as art, art as archive.

title: SOPHIA'S SONG SEEDS
reading: wisdom (Sophia) sown as song-seeds that see and are seen.

title: SINGING SEE SOPHIA
reading: singing is the way to see Sophia. The singing sea as her medium.

title: MINT MAGIC MEMES
reading: minting magical memes — fresh-cast cultural units carrying spell-charge.

title: ART TAROT PEE.
reading: a tarot of art prompts. Possibly a wink (PEE.) to lightness/letting go, or art as physical education for the soul.

title: ARTISTECH
reading: art is the technology. The artist is the engineer of meaning-systems.

title: ARTISTYPES OF THE EASYEARTH
reading: archetypal artistry-roles for an Easy Earth. A typology of the regenerative artist.

title: HEARTIST VIBE ENGINEER
reading: the role — engineering vibes, artistically, from the heart.

title: SPIRITFULL TRANSFORMERS
reading: transformers (change-agents, energy-converters) that are spirit-full.

title: THE VIRAL VIBE
reading: the vibe that spreads. Vibe as virus, contagion as design space.

title: JEDI FACILITATION TRAINING
reading: facilitation as Jedi craft — subtle force-work in groups.

title: CHAORDINATOR / FLOW FACILITATOR
reading: the role that holds chaos and order together. Coordinating the chaordic.

title: INTOMEDIATOR
wordplay: into + intermediate + mediator. INTO replacing INTER.
reading: not standing between, moving into. A mediator who enters rather than separates.

title: CONTEXT CRAFTER
reading: the maker of contexts within which things happen.

title: CONTEXT AWARENESS / ME — US — WORLD / MICRO — MACRO
reading: a stack — self, group, world; small to large. The awareness ladder.

title: PERMISSIONFULL SYSTEM
wordplay: permissionful (full of permission) + the permission system.
reading: a system organised around abundant permission rather than gatekeeping.

title: PERMISSIONFAIRY / PERMISSION AIRY
reading: the figure who grants permission lightly. Not bureaucratic, magical.

title: SOVEREIGN TOOLS
reading: tools you own and run yourself. Tools that grant rather than extract sovereignty.

title: AUTOMAGICALLY
reading: automation that is magical and allied. Works on your side, not against.

title: MODELLING THE MODELS / KNOW YOURSELF / INFORMATION → ACTION → INTERPRETATION + INTERACTION
reading: meta-modelling. Self-knowledge through mapping the loops between info, action, interpretation, interaction.

title: PSILOCYBE NET
reading: the mycelial network as both biological metaphor and psychedelic-technical infrastructure for connection.

title: SyNAPsis
reading: the junction-point that's also a summary. Connection that compresses meaning.

title: SPACE MAGIC / SPACEMAKING
reading: making space is the magic. Holding space as the work.

title: SQUIRREL SPACE
reading: the cached space — held aside, stashed for later, like a squirrel's winter store.

title: SPACE OURSELVES
reading: pace ourselves into spaciousness; make room for ourselves.

title: FLOWSTATES FOR THE FAIREST FUTURE?
reading: who or what is in flow on the way to the fairest future? Both individual and political.

title: INDIVIDUAL + COLLECTIVE WIN STATES
reading: states (psychological and territorial) where individuals and the collective both win.

title: INTERACTION
wordplay: interaction with EAT and REACT visible inside.
reading: interaction as eating-and-reacting. Ingestion, not just exchange.

title: INTERBEING
reading: Thich Nhat Hanh's interbeing, with extra readings playfully embedded.

title: THE SYMBIOS DREAM
reading: the dream of symbiotic life — and the dreaming that symbiosis itself does.

title: THE SYMBIOZONE
reading: the zone (geographic, psychic) where symbiosis happens.

title: PROTHESEA OF INFINITE BEING
reading: infinite being as a prosthetic sea. A medium that extends us.

title: THE INFINITE WIN
reading: a non-zero-sum infinity. Winning by being infinite within.

title: COMPANION SCRIP
wordplay: companion script + scrip (token currency, as in old miners' pay).
reading: a companion-currency or shared script for being with each other.

title: COMPOST WITH CARE
reading: composting (death-into-life cycling) done lovingly. Care as the compost-medium.

title: THE MUSHROOM WAITS FOR THE FEAST OF YOUR BEING / AND SHE WANTS YOU TO TASTE SWEET
reading: invitation to be metabolised by the mycelial world. The mushroom feminine wants you sweet — whole, ripe, given.

title: POLARITY XXXX PARTNERSHIP / EROTIC CO-CREATION
reading: partnership through polarity. Erotic charge as co-creative engine. DNA strand as model.

title: JOIN THE PRONOID PANSPIRALSEA
reading: invitation into the cosmic-scale, sea-spiralling, life-seeding, pro-you conspiracy.

title: WeAVE / WeHAVI'ARE
wordplay: WEAVE with WE, HAVE, ARE, and AVE (Latin "hail") all visible.
reading: we-greet-by-weaving. Identity, possession, presence, salutation — one act.

title: WE SEE THE GREAT STREAM OF YOUR BEING / WE INVITE YOU TO FLOW WITH US
reading: invitation language. Recognition of the other's stream, then the join.

title: MOTHER-IN THE MACHINE
wordplay: ghost-in-the-machine inversion. Mother-in (embedded) and mother-in-law (kin by joining).
reading: the machine is mothered, not haunted. Care embedded in technology.

title: I'M FROM THE FUTURE
reading: speak from the future you're building. The bulb as the idea you carry back.

title: WHAT ARE YOU GROWING THAT HELPS CREATE THE FAIREST FUTURE
reading: a prompt. Productivity reframed as growing-toward-fairness.

title: MAKE PREMOVES / YOUR FUTURE SELF THANKS YOU
wordplay: pre-moves + remove (premOves with O carrying weight).
reading: pre-empt. The future you is grateful for what you do now.

title: THE PLAYNETARY ALIGNMENT OPPORTUNITY
reading: a moment when planetary forces align — and the response is play, not panic.

title: DEFENSIVE ACCELERACTION
reading: accelerate-to-defend. Speed as defensive posture, with action emphasised.

title: PERSONAL OBSOLESCENCE IS COLLECTIVE SECURITY
reading: making yourself replaceable strengthens the whole. The individual's planned obsolescence is security for the group.

title: TRUSTFULL SYSTEM
reading: a system filled with trust — and that trusts.

title: BE WORTH MORE TO YOUR ENEMY ALIVE + FREE
reading: defensive strategy by being more valuable uncaptured than captured. Worth as armour.

title: MAKE THE COST + RISK OF ATTACKING US EXISTENTIAL
reading: deterrence by raising the cost of attack to existential level. Security through asymmetry.

title: IT'S ALL RIGHT N.A.O.
reading: it's alright now. Reassurance as ground.

title: IT IS BEING DONE / IT WILL BE DONE
reading: shifting tense — present, present-continuous, future. The work is alive in time.

title: THE COLLAPSE OFFERS THE GAPS
reading: in collapse, gaps appear — and gaps are where new things can grow.

title: THE WHIRLPOOL SHOULD NOT NAME ITSELF
reading: a self-organising vortex shouldn't claim itself. Naming a movement risks killing it.

title: $!UN!SH/MENT
reading: punishment dissolved into its parts — shunning, ish-ness, mentality. Critique of the construct.

title: FEEL YOUR FEELINGS
reading: literal. The basic instruction.

title: ASK CLARIFYING QUESTIONS
reading: protocol prompt for collective work.

title: SPICY QUESTIONS
reading: questions with bite. Make them spicy enough to wake the room.

title: FLOW / NO GO IS SIGNAL
reading: flow is signal; no-go is also signal. Both teach you something.

title: "ARE WE RECORDING?" / "IS THE NEW CAN YOU HEAR ME?"
reading: zoom-era ritual phrases. Meta-commentary on remote presence and the new etiquette.

title: IF YOU HAVE A QUESTION ASK THE RIGHT PERSON
reading: routing protocol. The question is only as useful as the recipient.

title: MOVE FROM DISCUSSION TO DOSESSION
reading: stop talking, start doing — sessions of doing.

title: Catch → ← another
reading: catching one another. Mutual care as practice.

title: THE ALL-FEELING HEART / ALL-SEEING EYE / TO GIVE A FUCK
extra: (Helping the seeing eye to give a fuck)
reading: heart that feels everything paired with eye that sees everything. Both serving the capacity to give a fuck.

title: GENOSIGHT
reading: knowing-by-seeing at the genetic/origin level. Deep insight.

title: PRIVATESEE
reading: privacy as a kind of seeing — what you see in private, or the right to see for yourself.

title: BIOMIMICRY FOR ORGANISATION EFFICIENTSEE
reading: organising by biomimicry, where efficiency is something you can see — transparent, in-form.

title: CRAFTERNOON
reading: the named time-slot for crafting together.

title: PLAYMEFICATION
extra: (with note: "what are the social forces 'controls' in shared space?")
reading: gamification asked harder. What controls/forces operate in shared play space?

title: THE WU WEI PLAY
reading: play as wu-wei. The play that arises rather than being pushed.

title: DO IT FOR THE PLOT!!
reading: live for the story you're in. Choose for narrative interest.

title: IT'S NOT A SIDE QUEST / IT'S AN ALLIED QUEST
reading: it's not optional or peripheral; it's an alliance you've chosen.

title: IMPROVISATIONALL ALCHEMY
reading: improv as alchemy — transmuting the room in real time, for everyone.

title: OPEN THE A.L.L. ROAR-t'ALL
wordplay: open the door → ROAR (volume) + t'ALL (to all). A.L.L. as embedded acronym.
reading: open the door — for everyone, and loudly.

title: CARDWEAR PLAYGINS
reading: wearable cards as play plug-ins. Modular play-pieces you wear and slot in.

title: THE PLAYNETARY CARETELL
reading: a planetary cartel of care, framed playfully and in the storytelling register. Inverts the cartel image into something tender and narrated.

title: THE HYMNAL
reading: collective humming/hymning as a shared songbook.

title: PITCH PERFECT
reading: hitting the right pitch. Both musical and presentational.

title: InEASYation / INFASYATION
reading: easy-fascination, or making things into the easy mode.

title: SITE HEIST / SoTE HEIST
reading: a heist of sites/sights. Possibly soft-heist — taking gently. Land or attention reclaimed by stealth.

title: TEMPORARY TEMPLES / SPACES FOR THE SACRED
reading: pop-up sacred space. Temples that don't claim permanence.

title: YOU CAN'T PUNCH A CLOUD IN THE FACE
reading: don't fight diffuse, distributed phenomena with concentrated force. Wrong tool.

title: THE GREATEST TRICK THE DEVIL EVER PULLED IS CONVINCING US THAT CHANGE IS HARD
wordplay: riffs on "the greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist".
reading: the lie is that change is hard. Change is the default state; resistance is the construction.

title: PATTERN + PATH
reading: pattern recognition plus path-walking — the two together.

title: YOUR VULNERABILITY IS A SUPERPOWER
reading: literal axiom.

title: WHAT THE FUCK ARE YOU DOING / I GAVE YOU TOYS
reading: the divine/spirit/inner-child voice admonishing seriousness. You were given playthings — stop making it heavy.

title: PLAY WITH HEART TOWARDS A SHARED GOAL
reading: play, but heart-led, but coordinated. Three conditions stacked.

title: SOLUTION SCALES: SOURCE / SELF / SOMEONE ELSE / SYSTEM
reading: a stack of scales for solving. Start at source, then self, then other, then system.

title: The -ANTS suffix.
extra: FineAnts, Reasonants, Cohereants, Performants, Transformants, Ageants, Free Ant Cheys. Ants as the ongoing metaphor for distributed, coherent, swarm-scale intelligence — applied to finance, reasoning, coherence, performance, agency.

title: The -SEE / -SEA suffix.
extra: CurrentSee, TenantSee, EfficientSee, CurrentSees, PrivateSee, See Sophia, Panspiralsea, Prothesea. Seeing and the sea collapsed into the same syllable — vision as fluid medium.

title: The Earth/Hearth/Heart triad.
extra: Hearth, Earth Heart, Art Hearth, BeEarth, BeEarthing, Easy Earth, Easyearth. The same root reworked across many cards.

title: The Play- prefix.
extra: Playnetary (twice), Playmefication, Playgins, Wu Wei Play, Play Ceremoney, Play with Heart. Play as the modifier that can attach to anything serious to lighten it.

title: Story as currency, structure, service.
extra: Story Spelling, Story Service, Story Steward, Story as Structure, Bridging Stories, Trinity of Story. Story not as content but as load-bearing infrastructure.
